summary: Full-stack RBAC testing (backend + frontend). Backend: 23/23 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_rbac.py covering register/login/me returning role+permissions, /admin/me 403-for-listener + 200-for-admin, admin-only PUT /admin/users/{uid}/role (with 403 guard for non-admin token), collaborator flow (podcasts perm allows GET+POST /admin/podcasts but /admin/users and /admin/settings return 403 as expected), admin endpoints (stats/applications/users/settings) still work, and public regression (/live/status, /podcasts, /news, /products all 200). Frontend: welcome gate loads on first visit with login form + 'Continua con Google' + 'Continua come Ospite'; guest button persists pdu_guest_mode=true and enters tabs; /prayer shows msg-login-prompt banner and submit text becomes 'Accedi per inviare' routing guest to /login; /messages behaves identically (testIDs are 'msg-login-prompt' + 'msg-submit'); podcast detail favorite button (pod-detail-fav) routes guest to /login; email registration from welcome logs the user in and Profilo screen shows the registered name + email.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' repeatedly logged on Home/other screens (web preview). Not blocking but should migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/... to boxShadow for RN Web / RN 0.76+ compatibility.
Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking; migrate to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Migrate any remaining `shadow*` StyleSheet props to `boxShadow` and `props.pointerEvents` -> `style.pointerEvents` to silence RN 0.76+ deprecation warnings (non-blocking).
Consider splitting server.py (1375 lines) into routers (auth/admin/rbac/content/merch) for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1375 lines; splitting into APIRouter modules is now overdue.

get_current_user correctly re-reads role/permissions from db.users on every request, so promotions/demotions take effect immediately without re-login. Verified via test_10_admin_me_for_collaborator (collab token issued before promotion sees the new role/permissions).
require_perm short-circuits for administrator/allowlist users - good.
PUT /admin/users/{uid}/role correctly protects the ADMIN_EMAILS allowlist (returns 400 if trying to change an admin's role) and filters permissions against PERM_SECTIONS.
Frontend AuthContext.can() correctly composes admin OR (collaborator AND permission in user.permissions).
